dataExportReady.subject: Your {instance} data export is ready
dataExportReady.preview: Your data export is ready to download.
dataExportReady.heading: Your data export is ready
dataExportReady.body: The copy of your data you asked for is ready to download.
dataExportReady.expiry: The download is available until {date}. After that, request a new export.
dataExportReady.signInNote: You will need to sign in to download it.
accountDeletionScheduled.subject: Your {instance} account will be deleted on {date}
accountDeletionScheduled.preview: Your account is scheduled for deletion. You can still cancel.
accountDeletionScheduled.heading: Your account is scheduled for deletion
accountDeletionScheduled.body: You asked us to delete your {instance} account. It will be deleted permanently on {date}.
accountDeletionScheduled.renewals: Your subscriptions, and paid subscriptions to your channel, have stopped renewing. Time already paid for runs until its usual end date, and nothing is charged again. Anything still paid past {date} ends with the account, without an automatic refund.
accountDeletionScheduled.share: Your {amount} member share comes back to you. The co-op's treasury will email you before {date} to ask where to send it. After that, you can still claim it by writing to {contact} and quoting the share reference {reference}.
accountDeletionScheduled.cancelInfo: Changed your mind? Cancel any time before then: your account stays, and the subscriptions this stopped renew again.
accountDeletionScheduled.notYou: If you did not ask for this, cancel now and contact {contact}.
accountDeletionCompleted.subject: Your {instance} account has been deleted
accountDeletionCompleted.preview: Your account and personal data have been deleted.
accountDeletionCompleted.heading: Your account has been deleted
accountDeletionCompleted.body: Your {instance} account was deleted on {date}. Your personal data has been removed.
accountDeletionCompleted.subscriptions: Subscriptions that were still running ended with the account. Nothing more will be charged.
accountDeletionCompleted.share: Your {amount} member share is still owed to you. To claim it, write to {contact} and quote the share reference {reference}.
accountDeletionCompleted.retained: Records the law requires us to keep, such as payment records, are kept without your personal details.
accountDeletionCompleted.farewell: Thank you for being part of {instance}.
